title: Confidence envelopes for the false discoveries with heterogeneous data
summary: In the context of selective inference, confidence envelopes for the false discoveries allow the user to select any subset of null hypotheses while having a statistical guarantee on the number of false discoveries in the selected set. Many constructions of such envelopes have been proposed recently, using local test families (Genovese and Wasserman, 2006; Goeman and Solari, 2011), paths (Katsevich and Ramdas, 2020) or interpolation (Blanchard et al., 2020a).
